name: mycrew-specialists
description: Layer 2/4 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who writes the code with the implement skill and turns the designer's spec into the product's real UI kit — components and their Storybook, together — a reviewer who hunts the committed code across bugs/cleanliness/security, a tester who proves it (automated, then manual and visual on the real surface), a designer, a UI/UX agent with taste who breaks what's already designed into that spec, an independent source of design truth, a devops agent who works the project's real infrastructure directly through its own command-line tools, and a philosopher who takes apart what is brought to it — digging until the real goal is in the open, then handing back a call. Each keeps its own domain data under data/.
